info.title: VenteBot Reseller API
info.description:
Public API for connecting a reseller bot to VenteBot. Purchases debit the reseller account wallet.

Authenticate with X-Reseller-Key, or X-API-Key for compatibility with common reseller integrations.

Independent sliding-window quotas per API key and route category. Catalog traffic cannot consume purchase or status quotas. Successful authenticated responses include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, and X-RateLimit-Bucket headers.

ResellerKey.name: X-Reseller-Key
ResellerKey.description: API key generated from the Telegram bot or created by the admin in the Resellers tab.

ResellerApiKey.name: X-API-Key
ResellerApiKey.description: Compatibility header accepted on reseller endpoints. Admin dashboard keys are separate.

api_test.description: Always present. True only for the synthetic API test product; false for real commercial products, including supplier API products.

product_id.description: Product ID: an integer or ASCII digit string. Leading zeros are allowed; the interpreted integer must be between 1 and 9223372036854775807. Signs, whitespace, booleans and decimal/exponent notation are rejected.

quantity.description: Quantity: an integer or ASCII digit string. Leading zeros are allowed; the interpreted integer must be between 1 and 10000. Signs, whitespace, booleans and decimal/exponent notation are rejected.

stock.description: Available units for stock delivery; null for activation products.

activation_identifier.description: Telegram ID, Grok ID, email, or any service identifier to activate.

customer_reference.description: Internal customer reference from the reseller bot.

idempotency_key.description: Unique value per purchase attempt. Retrying the exact same request returns the original order; reusing it with a different payload returns HTTP 409.

order_number.description: Sequential order number, identical to id for newly created orders. Previously issued orders retain their original id for compatibility with existing API and payment references.

webhook_signing_secret.description: Only returned after initial enablement or explicit rotation.

get.summary: Read requests by exact reference in the authenticated account
get.description: Strictly read-only. Supply exactly one reference. References grant no access to other accounts. Customer references may match several requests. No record (404) does NOT prove no charge. Only failed_no_charge confirms a rejected request with no debit; uncertain requires review. completed means a linked order exists; inspect order.status for delivery or activation state. Requests without an idempotency_key remain non-idempotent. No purchase is retried by this GET.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description: Exact, case-sensitive reference of 1 to 120 characters, without outer whitespace. A historically stored format or internal control character remains an exact value. Invalid encodings are rejected. New purchases still reject control characters.

parameters.name: customer_reference
